tasks.summary: Added independent principal and ordered durable lifecycle events in Memory and PostgreSQL with atomic rollback.
Added offline create/disable operator commands with explicit actor and no implicit migration. Credential commands were removed by security review.
Introspection was deliberately not shipped. No credential schema, token API, issuance route, or introspection route exists in this release.
Passed full and isolated PostgreSQL gates, pushed both remotes, deployed single-active, and created the zero-login/zero-grant production principal.
